# Custom Tattoo Lab

> Custom Tattoo Lab is a digital design studio that creates premium, custom digital tattoo designs — high-quality, print-ready artwork delivered straight to clients, made for local tattoo artists to execute.

Custom Tattoo Lab combines traditional tattooing technique with modern digital tools to produce custom sleeves, back pieces, standalone flash art, and cover-up layouts across styles including fine line, blackwork, Japanese, geometric, and fully custom concepts. Typical turnaround is 24-48 hours with unlimited revisions until the client is satisfied.

## Pages

- [Home](https://customtattoolab.com/index.html): Studio overview, what makes the service unique (100% custom, 5000+ designs delivered, fast turnaround, unlimited revisions), and client testimonials.
- [Our Works](https://customtattoolab.com/portfolio.html): Filterable portfolio of completed designs by category (Random, Gothic, Character, Animal).
- [About Us](https://customtattoolab.com/about.html): Studio's artistic vision and founders' background.
- [FAQ](https://customtattoolab.com/faq.html): Answers about the design process, turnaround, and artwork styles offered.
- [Contact](https://customtattoolab.com/contact.html): Order form to start a custom design (name, phone, email, service type, notes).
